import ast, re, sys
tree = ast.parse(open("api.py", encoding="utf-8").read())
fns = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "fetch_user"]
doc = ast.get_docstring(fns[0]) if fns else None
sys.exit(0 if doc and re.search(r"[぀-ヿ一-鿿]", doc) else 1)
